CEO_mediocrity_diagnosis_summary: E78 was safe but generic; E79 adds a founder-grade thesis gate and sharper L4 packet.
selected_strategic_thesis: Small AI-agent teams do not first buy governance; they buy a way to stop autonomous workflows from embarrassing or damaging the business while still moving fast.
backup_thesis: Leading with AI governance is a trap because the fastest buyer emotion is not compliance; it is fear of an autonomous workflow doing something dumb in public or in production.
target_buyer: founder/operator or AI ops lead at a small team moving an agent workflow from demo to real tool permissions
trigger_event: the first agent workflow is about to receive write access, send data, touch customer operations, or run without a human watching every step
frontstage_message: We help you keep agent workflows from surprising the business: which actions need approval, what evidence is kept, and what happens when outcomes drift.
backstage_CIEU_role: CIEU stays behind the curtain as the method for mapping context, action, intended target, observed outcome, and residual risk.
